build_order.name: Symbolic core
build_order.rationale: One shared piece of work (safe parser with log/sqrt/symbols/vectors, a generic hypotheses-and-goal spec, elimination and exact-zero checks) serves eight engines. Mostly high-feasibility text-only questions.

build_order.name: Calculus
build_order.rationale: Reuses the phase 1 parser and spec; adds diff/limit/integrate with domain tracking.

build_order.name: Discrete and logic
build_order.rationale: Small, decidable checkers with high feasibility; independent of each other.

build_order.name: Trig extensions
build_order.rationale: Extend existing code: constrained identities, special angles, branches, discriminant.

build_order.name: Synthetic geometry
build_order.rationale: Largest group but highest cost per question: figure encoding, Newclid adapter gaps and school-style write-ups. Needs the interpretation stage for figures.

build_order.name: Open-ended
build_order.rationale: Lowest automation yield; likely LLM-drafted with human review.

priority_formula: sum over unsolved questions of feasibility weight {"high": 1.0, "medium": 0.5, "low": 0.1}

engines.title: Synthetic Euclidean proofs (congruence, circles, similarity, areas)
engines.check: Newclid proof plus independent symbolic-coordinate check of the conclusion
engines.gaps: Coordinate proofs cover lengths, midpoints, parallels, perpendiculars and areas. Not yet: angle equalities (bisectors), circles and arcs, congruence/similarity write-ups, constructions; Newclid has one reviewed encoding

engines.title: Coordinate and 3D analytic geometry
engines.check: Distance, section, area and line formulas with exact arithmetic
engines.gaps: Not yet wired into this pipeline; symbolic-parameter coordinates

engines.title: Vector identities
engines.check: Generic 3D components, dot/cross product identities
engines.gaps: Either/or conclusions need case output

engines.title: Set identities, logic and counterexamples
engines.check: Per-element membership truth tables (decides these quantifier-free set statements); finite counterexample search
engines.gaps: Power-set argument (XI-026) is not per-element

engines.title: Determinant and matrix identities
engines.check: Symbolic determinant expansion and factor comparison; transpose algebra with noncommutative symbols
engines.gaps: Students expect row/column operations, so the trace must record them

engines.title: Relation and function properties
engines.check: Reflexive/symmetric/transitive by symbolic rewriting; injective/surjective by solving for preimages
engines.gaps: Geometric relation XII-008 needs counterexample by construction

engines.title: Complex-number identities
engines.check: Split into real/imaginary parts with real symbols; omega reduction via 1+w+w^2=0
engines.gaps: None beyond parser

engines.title: Probability from axioms
engines.check: Express events over Venn atoms with non-negative atom probabilities; linear/polynomial identity
engines.gaps: Independence is a product constraint

engines.title: Mathematical induction
engines.check: Base case evaluation and symbolic step P(k) => P(k+1) (sum or divisibility quotient)
engines.gaps: None beyond parser

engines.title: Factorial and binomial-coefficient identities
engines.check: Symbolic factorial ratios and general-term exponent matching
engines.gaps: Products like 1.3.5...(2n-1) need a double-factorial encoding

engines.title: Derivatives, implicit differentiation, first principles, ODE verification
engines.check: SymPy diff/limit and substitution back into the stated relation, with domain
engines.gaps: Two curves at once (XII-020, orthogonal curves); first principles covers roots, products with trig and polynomials

engines.title: Relations under given conditions
engines.check: Eliminate hypotheses (substitution, Groebner basis or parametrisation) and reduce target to zero; record non-zero divisors
engines.gaps: Inequality givens; componendo–dividendo is implemented as a prescribed method (X-009)

engines.title: Contradiction, irrationality and inequalities
engines.check: Case analysis and certified inequalities
engines.gaps: Sum of discriminants and 'only real solution' are implemented; irrationality and triangle inequalities are not

engines.title: Exact algebraic, index, log and surd identities
engines.check: Exact simplification of LHS - RHS with recorded domain (positivity for logs/indices)
engines.gaps: Radical equations; nested surds

engines.title: Definite integrals and areas
engines.check: Exact integration, reflection property, region bounds
engines.gaps: Antiderivatives from school substitutions and SymPy's step-by-step integrator; integration by parts not yet

engines.title: Maxima/minima and monotonicity
engines.check: Critical points, second-derivative or sign test on the stated domain
engines.gaps: Exactly one critical point in the domain; closed-interval endpoint comparisons not yet

engines.title: Inverse trigonometric identities
engines.check: Principal-branch interval tracking, then exact tan/cos evaluation
engines.gaps: Branch conditions are proved for numbers and for one variable on a stated interval; several variables not yet

engines.title: Length/area relations proved by Pythagoras
engines.code: mathcore/parse.py (points, dist2/dot/cross/area), mathcore/figure.py (figure facts checked), mathcore/render.py
engines.check: Symbolic coordinates with right angle at origin; identity in squared lengths
engines.gaps: Answers use coordinates, not Pythagoras on named triangles

engines.title: Factor theorem, completing the square, discriminant
engines.check: Remainder evaluation, expand-back, discriminant identity
engines.gaps: Higher-degree factorisation beyond the factor theorem

engines.title: AP/GP term and sum relations
engines.check: Substitute general term/sum formulas and simplify the claimed relation
engines.gaps: XI-006 is solved by naming the larger number first (b + d, d >= 0)

engines.title: Trigonometric identities
engines.check: Permitted-rule rewrite search, exact equality, domain replay
engines.gaps: Special-angle products that need the multiply-by-2-sin trick (e.g. sin 20° sin 40° sin 60° sin 80°). General solutions are implemented (mathcore/strategies/general.py).
